\deflang1033\pard\plain\f2\fs22\b Summary:  \plain\f2\fs22 This Ordinance adopts the Land Use Assumptions that provide the basis for the Growth Capital Improvement Program that is used in calculating development impact fees.  The Land Use Assumptions contain projections, by sub-area, of growth in population, housing and jobs over the periods 2000 \endash  2010 and 2010 \endash  2025.  The Growth Capital Improvement Program identifies the costs associated with providing the public infrastructure and services to accommodate that growth.  These costs are apportioned to new development in the form of impact fees.\plain\f2\fs22\b 
\par \plain\f2\fs22 
\par \plain\f2\fs22\b Fiscal Impact:\plain\f2\fs22   None, for adopting the Land Use Assumptions.  \plain\f2\fs22\b 
\par \plain\f2\fs22 
\par \plain\f2\fs22\b Comments:  \plain\f2\fs22 The NM Development Fees Act and the legislation adopting the Planned Growth Strategy require that Land Use Assumptions be adopted by the Council and that the Council be advised and assisted in that action by the Impact Fee Committee.  The Impact Fee Committee voted to recommend the Land Use Assumptions be adopted and a letter conveying that recommendation is included in the bill packet.
\par 
\par \plain\f2\fs22\b Questions:\plain\f2\fs22   \plain\f2\fs22\b 
\par \pard\li720\fi-360\plain\f2\fs22 1.\tab What is the relationship between these Land Use Assumptions and the Infrastructure and Growth Plan adopted by the Council in October 2003?
\par 2.\tab What is the length of time for which the Land Use Assumptions hold?
\par \pard\plain\f3\fs23 
\par }
